name: cleanpro
description: CleanPro website — frontend (my-app) + backend, run together from one place

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix my-app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix my-app"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
